notes.title: June-July Playtest Registration
notes.notes: [h3][b]SteelFront needs your help![/b] We will begin a series of demo playtests starting on the 27th. They will not have a predetermined end date, rather we expect them to guide us along the course of development.[/h3][p][/p][p]Although [b]you will be able to request access through the Steam Store[/b] page as normal, registering through the following form may give you [b]anticipated access[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667373/e38a6305e9bfb31c7ce346c221f660a066acd372.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfT26nXdIdmjjQo4-BqGhgq0MNEamHmHiXxZvDG2JQzBuPaOg/viewform"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfT26nXdIdmjjQo4-BqGhgq0MNEamHmHiXxZvDG2JQzBuPaOg/viewform[/url][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] We reserve the right to select users based on internal priorities, with all submissions reviewed manually. [/h3][h3]Users who are accepted are not entitled to a full copy of the game, the demo version may be closed and/or removed at any point in the development process.[/h3][h3]Access to the playtests might be temporarily stopped due to technical issues and/or delays.[/h3]
